title: The video properties look like the rest of the design, with no paragraphs
goal: The panel beside a recording is full of paragraphs and debug-like controls, its values clip at the edges, and the controls you use most sit at the bottom. Make it look like the rest of the app and the mock: tidy label and value rows, a dropdown for speed, rare actions on right-click, and what you are using near the top.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The panel under a recording is Reframe (raw Scale/Centre, 'Sharp to 100%', a 'Drag a box with M' paragraph), Time (a freeze explainer paragraph, a 'While the frame is held' radio group, three status sentences, a 7-item Speed radio list with 'silent' tags), Captions (a button and a paragraph), all with no horizontal inset so values clip. The user: 'It has paragraphs of text in there. it exposes features that are the most confusing, dev-debug like tools possible'. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Every video section uses the standard panel inset and label/value rows as the mock's PROPERTIES draws them
Zero explanatory sentences in the video sections (SpeedInspector, ReframeInspector, CaptionsInspector, TransitionInspector, SoundInspector); a test asserts no panel string over 60 characters in them
Speed is one dropdown row; Freeze Frame moves to the clip's right-click menu and its options to a submenu; the 'While the frame is held' radios are gone from the panel
Reframe as a section is gone: scale and position are the layer's ordinary transform, animated by keys (see the motion task), with Punch In as a right-click preset
Side-by-side with video.html PROPERTIES in the audit
At 1200 by 720, with a clip, a sound or a title picked, its speed, its level and its fades are on screen without scrolling (carried from the dropped panel-order task)
The panel order follows a written rule about what the layer is for, not a hand-kept list, and a walk reads it back for a clip, a title and a sound

log.note: Folded in from the-section-you-are-using-is-the-one-you-scroll (triage 2026-09-23): the panel order is a hand-kept list, so every video section landed at the bottom.
